lines.t: The night is long and I'm still awake
Whispering prayers and my heart can't shake
Your name is on every breath I sigh
Yeah, who's you? I'm waiting for the sky
Every tear is a token of faith
Every dawn I'm chasing your grace
Your promise burns like morning light
Calling me home through the endless night
Oh, my bridegroom, come quickly now
I've trimmed my length, I've kept my vow
My heart beats only in your tune
I'm waiting, but love it until you come soon
This world feels heavy, but you're light
Love is real, in the quiet still Your spirit I feel, you say, you come
I hold that word, each echo of truth is my comfort
Though the earth trembles and mountains fade Your covenant stands, my heart won't trade
The signs are stirring, the trumpet will sound
And I'll meet you there where love is found
Oh, my diagram, come quickly now
I've trimmed my limp, I've kept my vow
My heartbeat's only in your truth
I'm waiting, beloved, until you come soon
Adorned in white, I lift my eyes
The heavens open, the end of goodbyes
Every longing finds its release
In your arms, eternal peace
Oh, my bridegroom, your light breaks through
The dawn has come, I'm running to you Forever beacons where shadows are done
I'm home with you, my yahoo, sure now we're one
Thank you.
